ed continuation of CypherNaught-0x/DSH-Subagent-Model-Router.
# DSH Subagent Model Router
**Give every delegated task the right model and reasoning effort—automatically.**

> [!NOTE]
> This is the maintained continuation of CypherNaught-0x/DSH-Subagent-Model-Router, includ
ing poka-IT's DSH 0.1.7/0.2.0 port. It targets DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x and adds per-task reasoning ef
fort. Full history and credit are preserved.
Stop using one model for every kind of work. Configure your preferred fast, affordable, specialized,
and high-reasoning models once; the router gives your agent the aliases, tags, and guidance it need
s to intelligently select the best route for each delegated task.
That means faster routine work, stronger results on difficult problems, better control over cost, an
d less model micromanagement. Subagents can run in parallel, their results are reliably joined befor
e the parent responds, and the model chosen for each task stays visible throughout the UI.
## Why use it?
- **Better results where they matter** — reserve your strongest models for architecture, security, d

eep reasoning, or critical review.
- **Lower cost and latency** — send routine searches, edits, and

focused implementation work to faster or more economical routes.
- **Automatic, task-aware routing**
— friendly aliases, capability tags, and plain-language usage guidance help the orchestrator choose

intelligently.
- **Per-task reasoning effort** — the orchestrator can run the same route at `low` f

or mechanical work or `xhigh` for a stubborn bug, with an optional default per alias.
- **Confident
parallel delegation** — launch multiple specialists in the background and reliably collect every res

ult before synthesis.
- **Clear model visibility** — see which model actually handled a task in suba

gent headers and in the optional Better Sidebar **Sub-agents** tab.
- **Easy setup** — configure you
r model team from the Web UI, through a guided skill, or directly in a Cordis patch.

> [!TIP]
> Already using Better Sidebar? The router adds an optional **Sub-agents** tab through Bett
er Sidebar's public `registerTab` API.
## What it adds
- `subagent_model`: a delegation tool whose `model` argument is restricted to user-configured aliase

s, with an optional `reasoning_effort`.
- `wait-for-subagents`: a join tool that waits for this agen
t's outstanding continuable background children, including standard and model-routed delegations, an

d returns their terminal results.
- Per-model tags and routing descriptions embedded in the tool sch

ema and system prompt.
- `model_subagent_catalog`: a read-only view of models advertised by register

ed LLM providers.
- `configure_subagent_models`: a model-facing tool that reads or replaces only thi

s plugin entry's configuration, without filesystem access.
- `model-subagent-setup`: a guided skill
for selecting routes, generating routing guidance, obtaining confirmation, and saving through the co

nstrained configuration tool.
- **Settings → Subagent Models**: a Web settings page for manually add

ing, editing, and removing routes.
[该节后续省略]
## Compatibility
| Plugin version | DeepSeek Harness | Configuration store |
| `0.10.0` | `0.1.7-rc.2` through `0.2.x` (verified daily on `0.2.0-rc.2`) | Loader entry `config:`

in a Cordis patch |
| `0.9.0` | `0.1.7-rc.2` and later `0.1.7` builds | Loader entry `config:` in a

Cordis patch |
| `0.8.0` and earlier | `0.1.0-rc.6` to `0.1.6` | `subagent-model-router` section of
`~/.dsh/settings.yaml` |
DSH 0.1.7 removed `settings.yaml` and the `ctx.settings.register()/get()/watch()` API. A plugin now
declares a Config schema whose fields are `.volatile()`: DSH commits a changed value into the runnin
g plugin and emits `loader/volatile-update` instead of remounting it, and the Settings service (`ctx
.settings`) exposes those fields as a form addressed by the plugin's Loader entry id. This release t
`) exposes those fields as a form addressed by the plugin's Loader entry id. This release therefore:
- declares every setting as a volatile Config field and reloads its routes on `loader/volatile-updat

e`;
- writes through `ctx.settings.replace('dsh-subagent-model-router', …)`, which persists into the

active profile's `cordis.patch.yml`;
- takes `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` as a peer dependency, becau
se DSH resolves only peer dependencies of a linked plugin root from the running installation and `.v

olatile()` exists only in the 0.1.7 copy;
- leaves the session-header subagent catalog to DSH, which
now renders it from the `subagentCatalog` projection.
On first boot, DSH 0.1.7 renames `~/.dsh/settings.yaml` to `settings.yaml.imported` and imports each
section into the entry whose id matches the section name. The old `subagent-model-router` section d
oes not match the entry id `dsh-subagent-model-router`, so it is not imported: move it by hand into
a Cordis patch as shown in Configure through a Cordis patch.
DSH 0.2.0 no longer exposes `Agent.inbox.hasPending`; the router detects parked input from the publi
c `inbox.nextTurn`/`inbox.nextStep` lists and still accepts the older flag.
DSH 0.1.7 also caps a parent at 8 active continuable children (`maxActiveSubagents` of the Host `sub
agent` entry). A background `subagent_model` call beyond that cap fails with `ACTIVATION_LIMIT_REACH
ED`; wait for a child to finish or raise the cap.
## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness `0.1.7-rc.2` or later, including `0.2.x`
- The Web profile and built-in subagent

conversation UI
- A preset exposing the normal skill loader/tool
- The Host `spawn` subagent provide

r, included by standard DSH profiles
- Optional: a compatible `dsh-better-sidebar` release exposing
the public `registerTab` API (including the native right-sidebar surface)
## Known limitations
The native session-header subagent catalog shows no model chip: DSH 0.1.7 has no additive slot insid
e a catalog row, and this release no longer replaces the host's `subagent-catalog` cell. The `subage
nt-model` header chip is still registered at `priority: -1` so a host build that also fills that cel
l stays shadowed rather than clashing.
Better Sidebar's public tab registry is the supported integration seam. The router does not scrape f
oreign DOM, inject into native Tasks rows, or modify Better Sidebar source. The registered tab is op
tional and scoped to the service lifecycle; if Better Sidebar is unavailable, native headers, catalo
gs, settings, and model chips continue unchanged.
